approval_required_for: Any proposed DDR memory-layout change, AXI-protocol change, RTL-core lifecycle or pipeline change, exact board-wrapper/source-identity change, semantic-testbench contract change, checkpoint/stimulus/reference replacement, or numeric-policy/tolerance change; none is authorized by the bounded action above.

consumes: current case_board_interface_discovery identity document and exact wrapper/source-hash evidence
current target-model reference manifest with independent expected-output provenance
current semantic-testbench manifest, input provenance, and immutable numeric policy
existing generated DUT weight-binding manifest and exact-board loader/harness sources
sacg_memory_truth active contamination barriers and open retry requests
executable_actions.on_failure: Keep all current contamination barriers and retry requests active; emit the catalog-to-loader omission report and return to this board-layer verification-capability repair. Do not substitute sampled weights, alter checkpoint/stimulus/oracle/tolerance/testbench/wrapper hashes, run dependency-blocked functional tools as acceptance, edit lifecycle behavior, or reopen operator-leaf or connected-kernel verification. If closure would require DDR memory-layout, AXI-protocol, RTL-core-lifecycle, architecture, or exact-wrapper identity changes, stop and request bounded approval rather than making the change.
produces: verification/real_weights/full_transformer_block_tensor_catalog.json with complete-scope tensor hashes for every target layer
generated/memory/dut_weight_binding_manifest.json candidate binding every cataloged in-scope tensor through the exact-board loader/harness
verification/board_axi_ddr/multilayer_weight_binding_audit.json identifying catalog-to-loader-to-DUT runtime-stream coverage, omissions, shapes, ordering, and source identities
repair handoff recording that actual DUT consumption, functional simulation, AXI/DDR checks, and board semantic evidence remain pending after a static binding pass
executable_actions.rationale: The earliest executable current-layer failure is incomplete multilayer real-weight binding, not a localized hardware defect. Repair only the exact-board loader/harness binding manifest or its bounded generation logic so that every hash-cataloged Transformer-block tensor for every target layer is mapped to the current exact-board DUT runtime stream. Preserve the existing checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference outputs, numeric policy, testbench protocol, user wrapper identity, and source hashes. This establishes the prerequisite static binding contract but does not claim executed DUT consumption or functional hardware correctness.

observations: The decisive current executed gate failure is real_tool.case_multilayer_pipeline: multilayer_real_weight_binding does not establish that the exact-board DUT binding covers every Transformer-block tensor in every target layer. The missing semantic-evidence report and all not_run board functional/AXI/DDR gates are consequential dependency gaps, not independent RTL failures.

Contract-guided debug closure classifies this as a verification-capability gap and explicitly blocks a hardware boundary-trace request until the semantic loader/weight-binding capability is repaired. No valid current localized failure boundary, root module, or lower-layer challenge is present.

Hash-validated lower-layer evidence is closed: the connected-kernel replay accepted 416 records with complete 1792-beat ingress and egress, terminal last, preserved boundary liveness, and fresh VCS execution. There is no current hash-bound direct core start, ingress, egress, and named-causal-boundary trace contradicting that certificate or the operator-leaf certificate.

Prior lifecycle feedback is planning-only and explicitly marks source_semantic_repair_eligible=false. Its ingress-complete/output-zero symptom authorizes neither adapter behavior edits nor a connected-kernel replay. Historical VCS diagnosis is additionally not current-source-bound because cited live hashes changed.

sacg_memory_truth has active contamination barriers and six open same-scope retry requests, including retry_request.0136 and retry_request.0140 for case_multilayer_pipeline/functional_sim. Rejected Stage7/Stage8 artifacts remain planning/debug evidence only; this action creates a candidate repair and cannot clear retry or promotion barriers until a later complete Stage7 rerun passes.
proposed_actions: Repair only the exact-board Transformer-block weight-binding capability: generate and hash-audit the complete target-layer catalog, bind every required tensor through the current exact-board loader/harness without changing the immutable board/testbench/model contract, and rerun case_multilayer_pipeline. Hold all downstream AXI/DDR functional actions and all lower-layer replays.
risks: A catalog that is complete on disk but is not hash-bound per target layer to the exact-board loader/harness and DUT runtime stream would still fail the contract; sampled tensors or RTL-derived expectations are prohibited.

This targeted static binding repair does not prove executed DUT weight consumption, AXI correctness, DDR image correctness, liveness, output order, lifecycle progress, or numeric correctness. Those require later exact-wrapper real-tool runs after prerequisite gates pass.

The current exact wrapper/source identity and Vivado-authorized simulation plan must remain bound. Any stale identity document, wrapper substitution, or source-hash drift invalidates the candidate and must not be hidden by a manifest update.

Checkpoint, input provenance, independent target-model expected outputs, semantic-testbench hashes, numeric policy, and tolerance must not change during repair; no tolerance may be derived from DUT output.

Tensor-to-runtime mapping has cross-layer shape, data-order, address-map, and DDR-layout risks. This action may correct binding metadata/loader behavior only; it must not change memory layout, AXI protocol, pipeline architecture, or certified kernel timing semantics.

current semantic-testbench manifest and immutable numeric policy

output.summary: Fail closed at board_axi_ddr_wrapped_system. The sole next causal action is a bounded exact-board Transformer-block weight-binding/loader-harness capability repair followed by a targeted rerun of case_multilayer_pipeline. The currently executed failure is missing complete DUT binding for every Transformer-block weight in every target layer; all AXI/DDR functional tools are dependency-blocked. Do not edit lifecycle behavior, run board functional simulation, or reopen either certified lower layer until this prerequisite passes and a fresh current-source board trace exists.
